Seattle festival shooting: 3 dead, 1 arrested, police seek others

A shooting at a Seattle food festival near the Space Needle resulted in three deaths and several injuries. Police arrested a 15-year-old suspect and are searching for at least two other individuals believed to be involved. Authorities urged the public to avoid the area as they investigated the incident. Witnesses described hearing multiple gunshots and subsequent panic.
